run_modulation_dataset_writer: run the modulation dataset writer script to generate CELEBA modulations with a given latent dimension
create_modulation_dataset: create a dataset of modulations and PSNR values by fitting modulations via SGD on a Haiku model
load_pretrained_weights: load pre-trained LatentModulatedSiren model weights and config from a dill checkpoint file
build_latent_modulated_siren_model: build a Haiku-transformed LatentModulatedSiren model from a config dict for forward passes on coordinates
save_modulation_data: save train and test modulation arrays and PSNR values to a dill-serialized NPZ file
